legal.label: Privacy
legal.title: Privacy
paragraphs: This website does not store the data entered in the contact form on its own servers.

When you submit the form, your name, email and message are emailed to our inbox (cpinsai02@gmail.com), through our Gmail account or, as a fallback, the FormSubmit service, and used only to reply to you.
For any request about your data you can contact us at +39 339 427 7111.

legal.label: Cookies
legal.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This website does not use cookies, neither technical nor profiling ones, and does not include third-party tracking tools.
Fonts are served directly by the website, with no requests to external services.
